form.description:
An assignment is a non-employee’s time-bound association with a job.
This form is used for assignment profile management.
form.name: Assignments Profile

form.description:
A job is a time-bound initiative for an organization that contains assignments for a set of non-employees.
This form is used for job profile management.
form.name: Jobs Profile

form.description:
A non-employee is an individual contracted to perform work for a specific period of time. A non-employee can be associated to multiple organizations and assigned to multiple jobs.
This form is used for non-employee profile management.
form.name: Non-Employees Profile

form.description:
An organization is a grouping of non-employees and jobs that is used to manage work and permissions. An organization can be internal (e.g. team or department) or external (e.g. vendor, business partner, staffing agency).
This form is used for organization profile management.
form.name: Organizations Profile
